question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

Maybe he wanted to make sure he didn’t embarrese her.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"embarrese"** is incorrectly spelt.

 
 
• **Meaning:** The correct spelling is "embarrass," which means to cause someone to feel awkward, self-conscious, or ashamed. (शर्मिंदा करना)
 
• **Example:** He didn't want to embarrass her in front of her friends.
 
 
 
• **"embarrass"** is the correct spelling. (शर्मिंदा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** I was embarrassed when I tripped on the stage.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrectly spelt word "embarrese" should be corrected to "embarrass".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **sware** (कसम खाना): Incorrect spelling of "swear," which means to make a solemn statement or promise.

 
 
• **Example:** He swore to tell the truth in court.
 
 
 
• **shure** (निश्चित): Incorrect spelling of "sure," which means confident in what one thinks or knows.
 
 
• **Example:** Are you sure you locked the door?
 
 
 
• **emberess** (शर्मिंदा करना): Incorrect spelling of "embarrass."
 
 
• **Example:** She didn't want to embarrass herself by asking a silly question.
